newsitem.title: EGYPT: Peace to help Arab-Israeli economic ties - Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Peace to help Arab-Israeli economic ties - Jordan.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein said on Tuesday that Middle East peace was needed for the success of a conference next month intended to integrate Arab and Israeli economic cooperation.
"I think that there are doubts among all of us that there will be any rush toward this conference like there was before because of the situation in which we are living," he said.
"In order for conferences to succeed in this regard, there is no escape but for there to be a just and complete peace."
The Jordanian monarch spoke to reporters after a meeting in this Sinai resort town with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on ways to push forward Middle East peace negotiations.
He said he would not attend the conference in Cairo but Jordan would send a delegation.

The conference, which follows similar gatherings in Casablanca in 1994 and Amman in 1995, is meant to take place from November 12 to 14, with 85 states and more than 25 international organisations taking part.
